item.title: Dharavi Chess Championship 2025 To Unite Over 200 Young Minds
item.description: Nav Bharat Mega Developers Private: In the last many decades of its existence, Dharavi has produced many talented doctors, lawyers, artists, engineers, and sportspersons. It is the first time that one of Asia’s most densely populated informal settlements is gearing up for a vibrant showcase of strategy and youthful talent as the Dharavi Schools Chess Championship 2025.

item.title: TPL 7: GS Delhi Aces Maintain Momentum At The Top; Gujarat Panthers Register First Win On Day Three (Ld)
item.description: Gujarat University Tennis Stadium: Gujarat Panthers registered their first win of the tournament, while GS Delhi Aces strengthened their hold at the top of the table on the third day of the Tennis Premier League (TPL) Season 7, which witnessed thrilling action and close finishes at the Gujarat University Tennis Stadium in Ahmedabad on Thursday. Yash Mumbai Eagles and SG Pipers also secured wins in their respective matches.

item.title: 2nd Test: Duffy's Five-for Powers NZ To 9-wicket Win Over WI In Wellington
item.description: World Test Championship: Jacob Duffy claimed his second five-wicket haul of the series as New Zealand beat West Indies by nine wickets in the second Test, taking a 1-0 lead in the three-match series with one game remaining.

item.title: Freiburg, Stuttgart Edge Closer To Europa League Knockouts
item.description: UEFA Europa League: SC Freiburg strengthened its position in Europe with a 1-0 victory over Salzburg, taking an important step toward the next phase of the UEFA Europa League.

item.title: NZ Move To Third In WTC Standings After 9-wicket Win Over WI In Wellington
item.description: ICC World Test Championship Final: New Zealand have boosted their prospects of a second appearance in the ICC World Test Championship Final with a comprehensive nine-wicket victory over the West Indies in the second Test in Wellington on Friday.

item.title: De Paul Completes Permanent Inter Miami Move
item.description: Rodrigo De Paul: Inter Miami have exercised an option to sign Argentine midfielder Rodrigo De Paul on a permanent deal, the MLS club said.

item.title: India Assistant Coach Ten Doeschate Wants Gill To Play T20Is In The Way He Fares In IPL
item.description: T20 World Cup: India assistant coach Ryan ten Doeschate said he wants Shubman Gill to bring his IPL batting template into the T20I set-up, adding that he believes the right-handed opener and skipper Suryakumar Yadav will come good closer to next year’s T20 World Cup.

item.title: India Lose 1-2 To Spain Finish 10th At FIH Hockey Junior Women's World Cup
item.description: FIH Hockey Junior Women: Indian women’s team went down 1-2 against Spain in its 9th/10th place playoff match in the FIH Hockey Junior Women’s World Cup 2025 at the Centro Deportivo de Hockey Cesped, Estadio Nacional, to finish 10th in the overall standings of the tournament.

item.title: Surya And Gill's Form Is A Real Cause Of Concern: Pathan
item.description: T20 World Cup: Former India all-rounder Irfan Pathan said the lean form of captain Suryakumar Yadav and vice-captain Shubman Gill, especially after another poor show in the 51-run loss in the second T20I, is a real cause of concern ahead of next year’s T20 World Cup.
